blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Youth groups across Eastern Visayas have strongly opposed the proposed Pax Silica initiative, warning that it could pave the way for the exploitation of the region’s mineral resources and intensify foreign military presence in their communities. In a joint statement on Nov. 21, the groups accused the Marcos administration of prioritizing US economic and military interests over national sovereignty. The said Eastern Visayas could become a target for resource extraction because of its deposits of bauxite, manganese, and chromite. “Our land is not yours to plunder,” the groups added, calling on students and youth organizations to unite against […]...
